title: SEC2: outbox_tick fetches attachments twice per message
description: In outbox_tick, messages().get() already hydrates msg.attachments via AttachmentStore::list_by_message internally (kith-store/src/message.rs line 177). outbox_tick then discards msg.attachments and immediately calls guard.attachments().list_by_message(&message.id) a second time (lib.rs lines 933-948). Every retry attempt runs two attachment queries instead of one. Fix: either use msg.attachments directly (it is already populated by get()), or add a messages-only get that skips attachment hydration for the outbox path. At Phase 1 scale this is two SQLite queries instead of one per retry — not urgent, but a clean fix.
